service_name.description: The service name to be registered in /etc/services and used in inetd.conf

port.description: The TCP port number on which the micro-httpd service listens

user.description: The system user account under which micro-httpd processes will run

server_path.description: The absolute path to the micro-httpd executable

document_root.description: The directory path that micro-httpd will serve files from
